item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Molecularly Designed Polymers for Sustainable Agriculture (Univ. PADOVA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-07 13:00
Institution: Univ. PADOVA, Padova
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-04 Chimica industriale

AGRIPOLYS is an European-funded project developing sustainable polymer materials to enhance agricultural productivity while reducing environmental impact. Through a multidisciplinary and intersectoral approach, the project will design fully biodegradable, functional polymers for applications including controlled agrochemical delivery and plant and seed treatments. Their performance, biodegradation and soil fragmentation will be assessed under greenhouse and pilot-scale conditions. Bycombining academic and industrial expertise from 11 research teams across Europe, AGRIPOLYS will train young researchers in the development of advanced, sustainable polymer materials for agriculture. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Theory and Simulation of Multidimensional X-ray Probes of Molecular Processes (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-02 Chimica fisica

This project aims to streamline the modeling, simulation and prediction of XFEL-based multidimensional spectroscopies to understand ultrafast molecular processes and guide new experiments. A multidisciplinary team from four academic and national laboratory institutions combines expertise in theoretical spectroscopy, nonlinear optics, quantum chemistry, nonadiabatic dynamics and code development. Three interconnected thrusts address methods and protocols, novel nonlinear X-ray signals, and applications to molecular systems and chemical processes. Experiments at XFEL facilities will be planned. Methods and simulations will use open-source codes (NWChem, OpenMolcas, NEXMD and SPECTRON) and be…

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Fate and reactivity of micro- and nanoplastics in the environment (Univ. TORINO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-11 13:00
Institution: Univ. TORINO, Turin
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-01 Chimica analitica, ambientale e dei beni culturali

The researcher should seek to improve their understanding of the environmental impact of microplastics and nanoparticles (MNPs), and investigate their potential effect on freshwater and wastewater treatment. Small microplastics (MPs) and NPs can interact with abiotic components (such as light and oxidants) in natural waters, as well as with strong oxidants during Advanced Oxidation Processes (AOPs). These interactions could disrupt natural processes and contribute to the degradation of plastic debris, releasing degradation products into the aqueous phase. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: 2026-IdrDip-05-farmaco - A NANO-theranostic tool TO prevent mechanosensing-dependent pro-fibrotic evolution and failure of the HEART (Nano-to-Heart) (Univ. PAVIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-22 12:00
Institution: Univ. PAVIA, Pavia
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-08 Tecnologia, socioeconomia e normativa dei medicinali e dei prodotti per il benessere e per la salute

The Nano-to-Heart project aims to identify and select a potential carrier capable of selectively targeting CD44-overexpressing cells, including cardiac fibroblasts and immune cells, for theranostic applications in myocardial infarction and other heart diseases associated with fibrosis. The specific activities covered by this appointment concern the optimization of the preparation of chitosan- and hyaluronic acid-based polymeric nanoparticles loaded with an antifibrotic agent.

Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-02 Chimica fisica

The goal of this research project i s t o dissect the mechanisms o f intracellular trafficking o f nanoparticles and the interactions/reactions of nanoparticles with cellular components to ultimately program and manipulate the nanoparticle induced cellular responses. The specific aims of this project are to engineer a set of biodegradable phytoglycogen nanoparticles with tunable size, surface charge and functionalities and to investigate their interactions with triple negative breast cancer cells and cancer associated fibroblasts

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Analysis of SMC waste for qualification for recycling processes (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-29 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-04 Chimica industriale

The activity involves the systematic evaluation and optimisation of the pyrogasification process applied to cured and uncured SMC waste. The aim is to identify the process operating window by studying the main parameters—temperature, residence time, atmosphere and thermal profile—and to maximise the retention of the fibers’ mechanical properties and structural integrity. Following the recovery process, the activity will focus on stabilising and consolidating the recycled fibers by applying sizing or binder systems selected in light of the previously determined surface chemistry and the properties of the resin to be used for re-impregnation. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-26 14:00
Institution: Univ. BRESCIA, Brescia
Field: Chemistry / 03/CHEM-06 Fondamenti chimici delle tecnologie

The research activity will focus on the development, synthesis, and characterization of advanced materials for CO₂ capture and conversion. The work will involve the design and preparation of innovative materials, including adsorbents, catalysts, and multifunctional materials, with tailored physicochemical properties for the selective interaction with CO₂ and its subsequent conversion into higher-value products. The materials will be characterized using spectroscopic, microscopic, telectrochemical, and surface analysis techniques, as well as evaluated through adsorption and catalytic activity tests.
